articles.summary: We deploy 1-10MW distributed data centers in existing industrial buildings with surplus power, which is 10+ times faster than standard data center deployment. We call our network of data centers the Rewbi Edge Inference Grid, which is designed for secure, reliable, and fast access to compute. Using our vertically integrated approach, our pilot B300 site was deployed in 39 days and is now live.
